mapper.select: SELECT mr.id AS record_id, st1.team_name AS supporting_team, st2.team_name AS opposing_team, sd.stadium_name AS stadium, mr.team_result AS team_result, ht.team_name AS stadium_team, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(mr.match_date,'+00:00','+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS match_date, st1.team_code AS supporting_team_code, c.category_name AS category_name FROM match_record mr JOIN team st1 ON st1.id = mr.supporting_team_id JOIN team st2 ON st2.id = mr.opposing_team_id JOIN stadium sd ON sd.id = mr.stadium_id LEFT JOIN team ht ON ht.id = sd.team_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = mr.category_id WHERE mr.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BINARY, typeHandler=com.example.backend.global.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler} ORDER BY mr.match_date DESC
